approach: Fix at two origins. (1) verify.rs: VerdictInputs gains `baseline: Option<&Baseline>`. A check is pre-existing only when it failed and the baseline has no note and holds an entry with the same name and passed=false. judge leaves such checks out of the reasons and the pass condition. New mark_pre_existing(&mut [CheckRun], Option<&Baseline>) prefixes the check note with a fixed phrase (no new CheckRun field, no schema change). (2) run.rs: always run the verifier (drop the all_passed gate); pass closing.baseline (only if its base_commit equals the job base) to mark_pre_existing and judge. A real failed check still fails the verdict, but every criterion gets its own result. introspect.rs and records.rs get small consistency edits; tests and CHANGELOG follow.

decisions.choice: Carry the pre-existing mark in CheckRun.note via a constant prefix PRE_EXISTING_NOTE in records.rs, with Baseline::failed_before(name) returning false when the baseline has a note or no entry.
decisions.reason: CheckRun is deny_unknown_fields, and the brief prefers the note. One helper makes the missing/empty/could-not-run rule live in one place (criterion 6).

rejected.why: Schema change on a deny_unknown_fields record.

rejected.option: Compute pre-existing only inside judge, no recorded mark
rejected.why: The record would not show the reader which failures were on the base (criterion 5).

decisions.choice: judge takes the baseline and decides pre-existing itself; run.rs also calls mark_pre_existing before building verifier inputs.
decisions.reason: Criterion 1 requires judge() alone to pass a base-failing check; the verifier also sees the note.

rejected.option: Flip passed to true for pre-existing checks
rejected.why: Falsifies the check record and the CI routing reads passed.

decisions.choice: Always run the verifier; judge still fails the verdict for a non-pre-existing failed check; the 'verifier returned no verdict' reason no longer depends on checks passing.
decisions.reason: The fault starts at the gate: one unrelated failing check left every criterion unjudged.

rejected.option: Run the verifier only when failures are pre-existing

decisions.choice: Ignore a baseline whose base_commit differs from the job base (in run.rs).
decisions.reason: A baseline for another commit says nothing about this base.

files.purpose: Add baseline to VerdictInputs, is_pre_existing, mark_pre_existing, judge changes, unit tests.
Drop the all_passed gate; mark pre-existing checks with the matching-base baseline; pass baseline to judge.
Add PRE_EXISTING_NOTE and Baseline::failed_before; update the Baseline doc comment; unit test.
failure_details skips pre-existing failed checks; add test.
Rewrite the verifier-skipped test; add pre-existing landing test and counter case; fix tests assuming no verifier on check failure.
Record the new behavior in plain language.

steps: records.rs: add PRE_EXISTING_NOTE and Baseline::failed_before (false if note is set; true only for same name and !passed); update doc; add unit test for empty, noted, missing cases.
verify.rs: add baseline to VerdictInputs; add is_pre_existing and mark_pre_existing (idempotent prefix).

verify.rs judge: only failed, non-pre-existing checks add reasons and block pass; the no-verdict reason no longer depends on checks passing; update existing test constructors with baseline: None; add tests for criteria 1, 2, 5, 6.
run.rs: filter closing.baseline by base_commit; call mark_pre_existing on check_runs; remove all_passed and the wrapper; pass baseline to judge.
Fix other VerdictInputs constructors (land.rs tests, run_pin_tests.rs).
introspect.rs: failure_details skips notes starting with PRE_EXISTING_NOTE; add test.
lifecycle.rs: rewrite the skipped-verifier test; add pre-existing landing test and counter case; fix other affected tests.
Run cargo fmt --all, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings, cargo test --locked.

risks.risk: Spending a verifier run on a job that will fail anyway raises cost.
risks.mitigation: The budget check already runs before each verifier call; the request accepts this cost.

risks.risk: A flaky base check failing in the baseline could hide a real regression.
risks.mitigation: Needs same name, passed=false, and a baseline for the same base commit; the note marks it for the reader. Retrying is out of scope.

risks.risk: Existing tests assert no verifier on check failure.
risks.mitigation: Update them in the same change; check-failure reasons still appear.

risks.risk: The verifier sees a failed check and may be confused.
risks.mitigation: The note is applied before the verifier inputs are built.

demonstrations.method: Unit test in verify.rs: baseline holds check `test` passed=false with no note; verification check `test` also fails.
demonstrations.observes: final_verdict is Pass; reasons contain no 'check test failed'; mark_pre_existing gives the check a note starting with the pre-existing phrase.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without baseline handling judge pushes 'check test failed' and the verdict is Fail, so the assertion fails.

demonstrations.method: Unit tests: baseline has `test` passed=true; baseline None; baseline with only another check name. `test` fails at verification in each.
demonstrations.observes: final_verdict is Fail, reasons include 'check test failed', note not marked pre-existing.
demonstrations.fails_without: If every failed check were treated as pre-existing the verdict would pass and the assertion fails.

demonstrations.method: Lifecycle test (rewrite of the 'without spending a verifier' test): candidate fails a check not failing at base. Read verification.json.
demonstrations.observes: Verifier role invoked; one result per acceptance criterion, each from the verifier (not 'did not assess'); final_verdict Fail; state Rejected; nothing landed.
demonstrations.fails_without: With the gate in place the verifier is never invoked and every criterion shows 'the verifier did not assess this criterion'.

demonstrations.method: Lifecycle test: config with a check `sh -c 'exit 1'` failing at base and after the change; everything else passes. Counter case: check passes at base, fails after.
demonstrations.observes: State Landed; baseline.json has the check failed; verification.json check failed with pre-existing note; final_verdict Pass. Counter case is Rejected.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without pre-existing handling the job is Rejected on the failing check.

demonstrations.method: Assertions on the stored check note in the verify.rs unit test and lifecycle test 4, plus an introspect.rs unit test that failure_details omits pre-existing checks.
demonstrations.command: cargo test -p athena-core verify && cargo test -p athena-cli --test lifecycle
demonstrations.observes: The pre-existing check note begins with the pre-existing phrase; a non-pre-existing failure's note lacks it.
demonstrations.fails_without: With no mark, the note assertion fails.

demonstrations.method: Unit tests on Baseline::failed_before and judge: baseline None, empty checks with no note, a note 'the baseline could not run: ...', and a matching failed entry plus a note.
demonstrations.observes: No check is pre-existing and the failure still fails the verdict in each case.
demonstrations.fails_without: Reading an empty or noted baseline as success would pass the verdict and fail the assertion.

demonstrations.method: Run the full gates, then confirm the new tests are in the run.
demonstrations.observes: All tests pass, including the new verify, records, introspect and lifecycle tests; then `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` report no warnings or diffs.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the change broke an existing test (for example one still expecting no verifier on a failed check, or a VerdictInputs call missing the baseline field) cargo test or cargo clippy --all-targets fails to pass or compile; unformatted code makes cargo fmt --check fail.

demonstrations.method: Read the new CHANGELOG entry under the unreleased heading.
demonstrations.observes: A plain-language entry says base-failing checks are marked pre-existing and no longer reject a job, and the verifier now judges every criterion even when a check fails.
